**Finding: compliant** (RENEWAL — Auto-renewal and non-renewal notice window)

This agreement does not use auto-renewal at all, so there is nothing for the rule to bite on:

- **Section 13.1 (p0627)** creates a single self-liquidating term — Effective Date until expiry of the Secondary Royalty Term, Product-by-Product and country-by-country — with no renewal term, no "automatically renew" language, and consequently no non-renewal notice window or renewal price uplift.
- A document-wide search for renewal language returns only patent-term renewals (definitions) and **Section 14.4 (p0672)**, which expressly disclaims any renewal or extension arising from post-termination conduct.
- The term structure favours us: on expiry the Section 2.1 licences convert to perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid-up, royalty-free licences to Ono, and **Section 13.2 (p0628)** gives Ono a without-cause termination right on advance notice.

No redline proposed.
